owner: Dr Christakos, Dr Nikoletos, Dr Walton and the team
summary: A named team and recent Toronto top dentist awards are strengths, but a request only booking flow and small inconsistencies appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: No booking form appears on the page: the only booking option is a Request An Appointment button that leads to another page, with no WhatsApp or live chat.
findings.cost: Every extra click before booking loses patients who want to book now.

findings.problem: Dr. Nicholette Nikoletos is spelled Nikoletta in her own bio, and the award source reads Post City Magazine in one place and Post City Magazines in another.
findings.cost: Name slips on a dentist's own page weaken trust.

findings.problem: Testimonials appear with first names only and no dates, the awards have no links to the publications, and the footer copyright shows no year.
findings.cost: Unverifiable proof reads as less believable.
findings.fix: Dated reviews linked to Google and award sources.

findings.problem: The mobile menu appears to use javascript:void(0), the Team and About Us menu items point to pages with mismatched names, and opening hours are repeated twice.
findings.cost: Navigation friction and repeated blocks cost mobile visitors.
findings.fix: Clean navigation and one hours block.

redesign: Booking on the page with WhatsApp.
Clean mobile menu and consistent names.
